keycols = ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']

t2 = t.set_index(keycols)['unblended_cost']
diff = (t2 - base).dropna()
print(diff.abs().sort_values(ascending=False).head(15))

print(top)

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
sub = df[df.account_id=='rNGYton'].copy()
sub['date'] = pd.to_datetime(sub['date'], format='%m/%d/%Y')
sub = sub.sort_values('date').reset_index(drop=True)
keycols=['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']
sub['key']=sub[keycols].agg('|'.join,axis=1)

target='2025-10-20'
t=sub[sub.date==target].set_index('key')

prior=sub[(sub.date<'2025-10-20')&(sub.date>='2025-10-06')]
med=prior.groupby('key')['unblended_cost'].median()
std=prior.groupby('key')['unblended_cost'].std().fillna(0)

res=t['unblended_cost']
delta=res-med
# z-score using median/mad robust
mad=prior.groupby('key')['unblended_cost'].apply(lambda s: np.median(np.abs(s-s.median())))
z=delta/(1.4826*mad).replace(0,np.nan)

out=pd.DataFrame({'cost':res,'median':med,'delta':delta,'z':z}).dropna(subset=['z'])
print(out[out.z.abs()>5].sort_values('delta',ascending=False))
